Employment: Part time - Ongoing Permanent

Eligibility Open to Everyone

About the Role:

Join our team as a Security-Orderly Officer and play a vital role in creating a safe, supportive, and caring healthcare environment. This rewarding position combines security, patient support, and teamwork, offering the opportunity to make a meaningful difference by assisting patients, visitors, and staff while contributing to a positive and therapeutic hospital experience.

What We're Looking For:

Essential Criteria 

Current South Australian Security Agent Licence.

Demonstrated security experience, including managing and de-escalating aggressive or challenging behaviours.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with diverse people and within a team.

Ability to work independently, use sound judgement, maintain confidentiality, and meet deadlines.

Knowledge of Work Health and Safety, risk management, customer service principles, and proficiency with Microsoft 365.

Desired Criteria 

Current First Aid Certificate and-or Certificate IV in Training and Assessment (desirable).

Training in managing challenging behaviours, mental illness, or personality disorders.

Experience in healthcare security and demonstrated manual handling skills.

About Us

The Riverland Mallee Coorong Local Health Network, called RMCLHN for short, supports more than 70,000 people living in country South Australia in the towns and surrounds of Renmark, Paringa, Berri, Barmera, Waikerie, Loxton, Pinnaroo, Lameroo, Karoonda, Mannum, Murray Bridge, Tailem Bend, Meningie, Tintinara and Coonalpyn. Click here for more information about working for RMCLHN.

We will provide support, both personally and professionally giving you access to a range of education and training opportunities designed to enhance your role.

Offer flexible work arrangements to better balance work, personal life, and family commitments.

Provide an inclusive workplace culture that values diversity, ensuring every employee feels a sense of belonging and safety.
